evidence.detail: rs/N extends the recovered Node class and contains twelve integer fields, with one field initialized to -1; this matches the classic spawned-object update record shape.
Client resolves the current Scene object at the record's plane/type/x/y coordinates, extracts the object id plus orientation/config bits, and stores those values back into rs/N.

Client iterates rs/N records from a NodeList, decrements two independent countdowns, installs either the captured prior object state or the queued replacement object at the stored tile, and unlinks the record once the transition is complete.
Classic SpawnObjectNode extends Node with the same twelve-int layout including a -1 sentinel and plane/type/x/y/id/face plus delayed replacement state.

proposals.note: SpawnObjectNode is a non-canonical semantic recovery name grounded in exact v308 behavior; historical client source is corroboration only where noted.

evidence.detail: rs/L implements Runnable and converts its InputStream/byte[] audio source through AudioSystem into 16-bit PCM_SIGNED, opens a javax.sound.sampled.Clip, starts playback and waits for completion before flushing/closing resources.
The constructor stores volume and delay, starts a dedicated thread, applies MASTER_GAIN through FloatControl, optionally sleeps before playback, and refreshes gain while the clip remains active.
Client's queued sound-effect loop retrieves sound bytes by sound id and constructs rs/L with the queued volume/delay values when the sound is ready.

proposals.note: AudioClipPlayer is a non-canonical semantic recovery name grounded in exact v308 behavior; historical client source is corroboration only where noted.
